alt: The unchanged starter scores 0.24 on the original grader against a documented 1.0 and 0.98 on the fixed grader, because the stored baseline of 5.13 bits per integer is below the 8-bit minimum and far from the measured 38.98.
caption: The original grader compares against stored baseline numbers the starter cannot produce, so it scores 0.24 instead of 1.0; the fixed version measures the starter itself.
